title: rpt finding record
description: One finding in a report. Schema version 1. Unknown members are allowed and must be passed through unchanged.

id.description: Finding ID; assigned by rpt add when absent.

severity.description: A severity level from the report config, e.g. critical, high, medium, low, info.

path.description: Path of the finding file, relative to the report root.

sections.description: Markdown per section: description, remediation, poc, plus any other ## heading under its exact text.

evidence.description: Evidence file paths, relative to the finding file's folder. Untrusted: must stay inside the report.

target.description: What the finding was found on. Set by parser plugins; read by rpt scope match, never rewritten.
